name: 2017 World Championships Deck: Ice Path FTW

releases.name: 2017 World Championships Deck: Ice Path FTW

description.text:
The deck that won the Senior Division of the 2017 World Championships, a Water deck built on Alolan Ninetales-GX, with Aqua Patch to power it up and Rough Seas to heal the team. Ice Blade can hit the Bench, Blizzard Edge hits hard, and Ice Path-GX moves all of Alolan Ninetales-GX's damage counters to the opponent's Active Pokémon. The 2017 World Championships were held at the Anaheim Convention Center in Anaheim, California, from 18 to 20 August 2017.

Pokémon sold it as a 2017 World Championships deck: a 60-card copy of the deck with a booklet, a deck box and a pin. Its cards have a limited-edition back, a silver border and the player's signature on the picture, and are not legal in tournaments.
